description:
How the environment counts usage the gateway estimated locally because the upstream reported none.

At most one document exists per environment, keyed by the environment id. Without it estimated usage counts like reported usage.

exclude_estimated_usage.description:
When `true`, a request whose usage the gateway estimated (any token counter it counted locally, so its usage event carries `usage_estimated: true`) adds none of its tokens to any token rate limit window (`tpm`, `tpd`, and a policy's `max_tokens`). Request-count limits and concurrency still count it, and its usage event still reports the estimated tokens.

Estimates the caller causes are excluded too: a streamed chat request that sends its own `stream_options` (the gateway then does not ask the upstream for usage), and a stream the caller closes before the usage frame arrives. Turn this on only where every caller is trusted.

title: UsageAccounting
